mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 AM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a crisp 51 degrees with clear skies around Harriet Park and a waning crescent moon overhead.
The Verona Plan Commission has several items on the agenda for November 4th, including site plans for the Sub-Zero facility at Liberty Business Park and a temporary use permit for 1979 Milky Way.
We have a busy start to the week with Hop Haus Trivia today, followed by tomorrow featuring the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market, Yoga at Insight Wellness, and trivia at The Bogey Factory.
In a noteworthy update from the police department, an officer made an arrest on October 3 after locating a suspect in a vehicle with expired registration, leading to the recovery of a stolen firearm.
Today's flavor of the day is the delicious Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie, and you can head over to the store when it opens today at 10:00 AM.
